name: Herb pots
description: A small cluster of three weathered, desaturated terracotta pots of different sizes, the largest about 0.3 m high, with bushy green herbs: basil-like leaves, a fine thyme-like shrub and one with a few small pale lilac flowers.

provenance.prompt: A small cluster of three clay pots of herbs of different sizes (the largest about 0.3 m high) with bushy green herbs: basil-like leaves, a thyme-like fine shrub and one with a few small pale lilac flowers, the terracotta desaturated and weathered. Inside one tile. Small decor: static, blocks nothing, cover none, not destructible.
